title: The word of width n
statement: Word n is the ring Z/2^n Z. Bitwise operations are defined from the binary expansion; shifts are multiplication and floor division by powers of two. Nothing is assumed: the carrier is constructed from the naturals.

formal.statement: Word n := Nat mod 2^n, with testBit i x := (x div 2^i) mod 2; and/or/xor pointwise on bits.

notes: In axeyum the kernel has NO bit-vector prelude yet: `BitVec w` is a per-width inductive built on the fly during reconstruction (crates/axeyum-solver/src/reconstruct.rs:370). Building a `word_prelude` on the 0-axiom `nat` prelude is the first increment of the book. See axeyum-guide/01-words.md.
